pr_body:
Replaces: https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/pull/22947
Fixes https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/issues/22946
Probably related to https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/issues/19530

Basically, many of the diffs were broken because they were comparing to the base commit, where a 3-dot diff should be comparing to the [last common ancestor](https://matthew-brett.github.io/pydagogue/git_diff_dots.html).

This should have an integration test so that we don’t run into this issue again.
pr_comments: `setCompareContext` has been invoked in 3 places, should we also change the left 2 palces?

> `setCompareContext` has been invoked in 3 places, should we also change the left 2 palces?

See [this comment](https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/pull/22949#discussion_r1111144126). The other two instances are "commit" and "pull" compares. We call before/after different things in both cases, but the logic appears correct.

<details>
  <summary>Outdated</summary>
I'm trying to make a simple integration test for this and getting a bit frustrated. I added the following to `compare_test.go`:

```
// Inderect compare with add-csv branch
func TestCompareDeleted(t *testing.T) {
	defer tests.PrepareTestEnv(t)()

	session := loginUser(t, "user2")
	req := NewRequest(t, "GET", "/user2/repo20/compare") // I will ultimately change this to compare actual branches
	resp := session.MakeRequest(t, req, http.StatusOK)
	...
}
```

 - Changing to `/user2/repo1/compare` works fine
 - Changing to `/user2/repo20/src/master` works fine

I thought maybe repo_units were wrong, so I added the following to `repo_unit.yml`:
```
-
  id: 82
  repo_id: 20
  type: 1
  created_unix: 946684810
```

Still no good. Am I not initializing something properly?
</details>

EDIT: Figured it out. Two issues - one, I was using the repo name (20) instead of the repo id (31) in repo_units, and second, I needed a "type: 3" repo unit.
Whoops, I broke linting. Will fix shortly.

issue_context.title: Diff breaks if csv deleted from base and head
issue_context.body:
### Description

Deleting a .csv file from both the base and head branch in a compare will result in a 500 error.

https://try.gitea.io/kdumontnu/test/compare/main...delete-csv

### Gitea Version

d9c6cb71e

### Can you reproduce the bug on the Gitea demo site?

Yes

### Log Gist

_No response_

### Screenshots

_No response_

### Git Version

_No response_

### Operating System

_No response_

### How are you running Gitea?

Seen on 1.17 initially. Reproduced on try.gitea.

### Database

None
comments:
```log
2023/02/17 02:58:03 ...s/context/context.go:231:HTML() [E] [63eeed3b-8] Render failed: template: repo/diff/csv_diff:3:15: executing "repo/diff/csv_diff" at <call .root.CreateCsvDiff .file .blobBase .blobHead>: error calling call: runtime error: invalid memory address or nil pointer dereference
```

Some contexts of this problem (just FYI):

* Issue #19530
* PR #19552
* PR #21189
OK, I fully understand the problem now. If a CSV file is deleted from both branch, then baseReader and headReader can both be nil.

review_comments: My understanding: the only key change is here, use `beforeCommitID` instead of `baseCommitID`. `beforeCommitID` was already prepared above. Other changes are just renaming (to match the variable meaning). 😁
